content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"We had a tentative attribution of HarborMesh checklist comment c1200, signed River, to Mara.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"That attribution came from a human report received through our code body on 2026-07-01; the reporter explicitly said they were unsure.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The checklist proposed numbering connectors before disassembly.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reported that we wanted to try that approach at the next repair.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"On 2026-07-04, a tool response received through our code body relayed the author's correction: they were not Mara Ibarra.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The author asked us to credit River, login river-tools, account ID 2901.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Mara's known Forge account remained 1847, with login mara-river.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"River had not supplied a real name, and the supplied memories do not record whether we tried the checklist.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
